launches.tagline: Building Autonomous Factories in America, Starting with On-Demand CNC Machining
launches.body:
We’re Hemant and Sam, founders of twentyfour26. We are building fully autonomous factories in America, starting with on-demand CNC machining.\
\
<https://youtu.be/5zW00NYwJno>\
\
**The Problem**

Factories have spent decades automating mass production. But most hardware companies aren't manufacturing millions of identical products. They need hundreds of different components, in changing quantities, with new designs coming every week.

Every new design requires its own machining strategy, tooling, workholding, programming, setup, and inspection. Much of this process is still manual, making low volume manufacturing slow, expensive, and difficult to scale.\
\
**What We're Building**

We're developing standardized manufacturing cells that bring machines, tooling, workholding, and inspection under a single system. Our models are being developed to interpret CAD designs, plan machining strategies, select tooling and setups, and operate the machines.

We're already manufacturing components for hardware companies in and around the Bay Area, with turnaround times as fast as \~48 hours. Operating our own machines allows us to develop and deploy automation against real production workloads.

Our goal is to make manufacturing 100 different designs as easy as manufacturing 100 units of the same design.

From individual components to complete assemblies, we want to abstract the entire manufacturing infrastructure into an API.\
\
**Team**

I've spent my career in hardware, from building ATVs and running supersonic simulations to designing products for high volume manufacturing. Across all of it, getting parts made was consistently one of the biggest bottlenecks.

Sam has spent the past decade building hardware and software for hardware. He sold his first company at 18 and moved into software after experiencing how slow hardware development was. For the past two years, he's worked with startups building vertical AI agents.\
\
**Our Ask**

**Teams building in space, defense, robotics, or anything else physical:** Have a part you're about to send out for a quote? Send it our way. We'd love to make it.

**Teams going from prototyping to production:** What's the biggest manufacturing bottleneck you'd pay the most to solve?

<https://twentyfour26.com>
